title: 10 AI Variety Shows Are Here! Zhejiang Satellite TV Introduces Seedance2.5 to Participate in Program Production

content_html:
Zhejiang Satellite TV will partner with Volcano Engine to produce its first batch of 10 AI variety shows, and the main episodes of the first batch have already entered production. On November 24, Zhejiang Satellite TV announced this partnership plan at its annual launch event. The shows are self-produced by Zhejiang Satellite TV and Z-Shijie, covering genres such as comedy, dating, mystery, and cute pets, including "AI Ace Special Edition", "Love Choice", "Mountains and Seas: The Journey Home", "Final Confession", "Did You Survive?", and "Woof Woof Island".

In terms of production workflow, the two parties will integrate scriptwriting, storyboarding, generated assets, and rough cuts into a single collaborative canvas. The production team can use a 3D director's platform to preset character blocking and camera movements, then use Volcano Engine Seedance 2.5 to generate low-resolution sample clips. After confirming character actions and visual style, they move on to later production.

This collaboration brings AI video generation technology into the variety show content production pipeline, covering multiple stages from early creative design to visual generation and editing collaboration. It reflects the exploration of generative AI in industrialized film, TV, and variety production, and also offers a new technological path for traditional TV content production.
